text:
mira: Heads-up — saw a perf regression on the decode path after yesterday's kernel-selector change. p95 decode latency up ~28% across toolcall-heavy traces. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: saw it on dedicated staging. Throughput dropped ~12% for chat flows that hit function calling.

diego: i've got a flamegraph, looks like frequent kernel swaps during paused decodes when tool calls happen. KV cache hits fluctuate a lot.

jen: can you paste the flamegraph snippet / logs?

mira: paste below — trimmed logs + sample batch formation info:

```
2027-11-18T09:12:01Z decode:start req=abc123 model=7b kernel=fast_fp16
2027-11-18T09:12:01Z batch:form size=6 token_budget=48 queue_policy=latency_pref
2027-11-18T09:12:01Z tool:invoke req=abc123 wait_ms=120 pause=true
2027-11-18T09:12:01Z kernel:swap old=fast_fp16 new=int8_swap cost_ms=14
2027-11-18T09:12:01Z kv:cache_hit=false key=chat_session:xyz
2027-11-18T09:12:01Z decode:resume req=abc123
```

sam: looks like the swap cost + KV miss combined with pause forms fragmented batches. we end up with many small batches and worse kernel choices.

li: also noted stop-token handling for structured tool output triggers early termination which creates odd short traces — hurts batch shape predictions.

chris: hypothesis: kernel selector uses last-observed seq_len distribution and assumes continuous decode. tool pauses break that, making it pick kernels tuned for short sequences, then we get thrash when resume extends seq_len.

perf-bot: regression-alert p95_latency +28% after deploy 2027-11-17T23:00 (kernel-selector v2.3).

mira: proposal: add a pause-aware feature to the batcher: if a request is paused for toolcall, mark batch formation mode as "pause-tolerant" and prefer stable kernels (avoid swaps) for X ms. Also bump token_budget_target for toolcall-heavy routes.

diego: concrete changes we can try in staging A/B:
- set `kernel_swap_threshold_ms = 50` (was 20)
- `token_budget_target = 64` for routes `*/tool*` (was 48)
- `max_batch_formation_ms = 12` -> `20` for pause-tolerant batches
- add `kv_cache_evict_threshold = 0.7` to reduce premature evictions

jen: good. also add a metric for "batch_fragments_per_request" so we can quantify split batches due to pauses.

mira: i'll run the experiment tomorrow: enable changes on a small subset of pods, keep kernel-selector rollback ready.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: kernel-selector:v2.3-pause-aware-experiment -> staging (10 pods) by mira at 2027-11-19T02:00Z

sam: once live, i'll run a synthetic workload with structured outputs and stop tokens to stress toolcall patterns. will share logs.

li: quick add — ensure canary includes both short and long sequence prompts. otherwise selector tuning will be biased. :thinking:

mira: noted. thanks all. if this fixes p95 we can promote change to canary dedicated next week.

chris: one more thought — add a backoff to kernel-swaps per-session (e.g., no more than 1 swap per 200ms) to avoid thrash when a session toggles between paused and active rapidly.

mira: agreed. i'll include swap-backoff param in the experiment.

ops-bot: reminder: create a postmortem-style doc in #incidents if this hits prod with >50% affected sessions.
